SELECT * FROM woorido.posts WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id, p.challenge_id as CHALLENGE_ID, p.created_by as CREATED_BY, p.content, p.is_notice as IS_NOTICE, p.is_pinned as IS_PINNED, p.like_count as LIKE_COUNT, p.comment_count as COMMENT_COUNT, p.view_count as VIEW_COUNT, p.created_at as CREATED_AT, p.updated_at as UPDATED_AT, u.nickname as AUTHOR_NICKNAME, u.profile_image_url as AUTHOR_PROFILE_IMAGE FROM woorido.posts p JOIN woorido.users u ON p.created_by = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id as FILE_ID, image_url as FILE_URL, display_order FROM woorido.post_images WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY display_order ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.posts WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND is_notice = #{isNotice}
